items.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 25 at 1:23PM EST until November 26 at 5:00AM EST by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and large breaking waves expected.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...Pinellas, Coastal Hillsborough, Coastal Manatee,
Coastal Sarasota, Coastal Charlotte and Coastal Lee Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 8 PM this evening
to 5 AM EST Thursday. For the High Rip Current Risk, from late
tonight through Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Rip currents can sweep even
the best swimmers away from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

A High Surf Advisory means that high surf will affect beaches in
the advisory area, producing localized beach erosion and
dangerous swimming conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 25 at 3:03AM EST until November 26 at 11:00PM EST by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 20 to 25 knots with gusts up to 30 knots and
seas 7 to 10 feet expected.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 11 PM EST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
